description: Return the parent chain for a taxon — from kingdom (or domain) down to the immediate parent of the queried taxon — as an ordered array. Each entry has its rank, canonical name, and taxon key. The array is returned root-first (kingdom → phylum → class → … → immediate parent of the queried taxon); the queried taxon itself is not included — call gbif_get_species for its own record. Useful for building taxonomic trees or understanding placement without navigating the backbone level-by-level.

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key from gbif_match_species or another taxonomy tool.

name: gbif_get_species_classification

classification.description: Classification chain ordered from root (kingdom) to the immediate parent of the queried taxon. The queried taxon itself is not included — call gbif_get_species for its own record.

items.description: A single rank entry in the classification chain.

key.description: Backbone taxon key for this rank.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The taxonKey does not exist in the GBIF backbone. `invalid_filter`: GBIF rejected the taxonKey as unparseable — a fraction, or a value outside the 32-bit signed integer range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the chain is empty because the taxon sits at the root of the backbone. Absent when the chain has entries.

title: Get Species Classification
